rules.assessment: The premium consumer blocks a parcel unless its Bergmahd definition is established. The strict >50% above 1200 m criterion is implemented in eligibility; general/input reports separately assess source hierarchy, Alm/home-site identity and types. A farm Alm flag is not reinterpreted here as proof of permission below the actual home site.

Der überwiegende Teil der Schlagfläche muss über 1 200 m Seehöhe liegen.

rules.catalog_statement: Mehr als die Hälfte (der überwiegende Teil) der Schlagfläche muss über 1.200 m Seehöhe liegen; dies gilt auch für Almbetriebe.

rules.assessment: Current-year mowing qualifies only with positive full_area and cut_material_removed evidence and no mulching. Current and previous-year history enforce the two-year interval after the first contract year. This corrects the prior run missing-removal/year-filter issues. First-year exemption and year-end-only evaluation are explicitly disclosed interpretations; history is assumed to represent completed qualifying mowing. Older precontract years alone cannot satisfy a later current/previous-year window.

zwei Jahre eine einmalige vollflächige Mahd sowie ein Verbringen des Mähgutes von der Fläche

rules.assessment: All mowing events in the application year are counted and more than one produces a violation. Prior-year events do not inflate the count. The event must represent one mowing operation with its main method, not separately entered finishing around rocks; duplicate identity is an upstream validation issue.

rules.catalog_statement: Es darf maximal eine Mahd pro Jahr durchgeführt werden.

rules.assessment: Current-year mulching and explicitly unremoved cut material each produce the source prohibition. Only full-area, removed and nonmulched mowing contributes to the qualifying-mowing frequency. Missing field behavior is independently assessed in the input report.

rules.catalog_statement: Die Fläche zu mähen und das Mähgut liegen zu lassen oder die Fläche zu häckseln ist nicht zulässig; das Mähgut muss jedenfalls von der Fläche verbracht werden.

rules.assessment: A current-year grazing start before 16 August is rejected and 16 August is allowed. However, the supplied end_date is ignored, so an interval beginning in a previous year and continuing before 16 August of the current year is missed. This is a temporal interval defect within the proposed period contract, not merely missing input.

rules.catalog_statement: Bergmähder dürfen grundsätzlich nicht beweidet werden; zulässig ist nur eine Nachweide ab dem 16. August (nach dem 15.08.).

rules.assessment: Postgrazing is allowed every year including BM0/no-mowing years, and does not count as a qualifying mowing year. Paired controls distinguish permitted postgrazing from satisfying the biennial mowing duty.

rules.assessment: The complete fertilizer-type allowlist is consumed on enrolled parcels with current-year event filtering; all nonallowed types generate the relevant prohibition. Positive mineral-nitrogen aggregate additionally generates a violation. Off-measure parcels are not subjected to this measure-specific checker; root tests that scope.
